status: Windows production control factory implemented and hardware-linked

factory_api.descriptor: AudioSessionControlFactoryV42 carries a production construct function, borrowed context, and shared context_owner pin.
factory_api.session: AudioNativeSessionV42 accepts the descriptor additively and retains its context owner until checked output closure, control thread join, and V42 final drain succeed.
factory_api.application_manager: AudioApplicationManagerV42 has an additive create overload accepting the explicit descriptor; existing API remains source-compatible.
factory_api.default_policy: Android retains AudioControlV40 as its default under __ANDROID__. Platforms without a default, including Windows, fail with Required actual platform audio control factory.

windows_control.ownership: Dedicated NativeSessionV42 control thread constructs WinmmAudioOutput over the same V42 mixer; publishes the same V42 AudioClockV40; checks the same AudioLifecycleGateV40 source epoch/focus; no PlatformSourceAudio or second runtime is created.
windows_control.lifecycle: WinMM open, actual focus pause/restart, TIME_SAMPLES/QPC clock publication, close_checked, worker join, and producer-side AudioGameplayRuntimeV42 final drain are covered.

validation.compiler: LLVM-MinGW clang++ C++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -static; linked Windows control, AudioNativeSessionV42, V42 runtime, WinMM, and winmm.
checks: Windows default without a supplied factory fails explicitly.
Pinned production Windows factory starts one native session and reaches focused WinMM readiness.
The same V42 clock publishes a valid generation, TIME_SAMPLES position, QPC monotonic timestamp, and 48 kHz rate.
Lifecycle focus loss pauses output and marks the same generation clock unready; focus restoration resumes and publishes a newer QPC sample.
Successful shutdown proves checked device close, control-thread join, V42 receipt/stop drain, runtime release, and release of the pinned factory context.
validation.compile_only: Native session and application manager translation units pass strict LLVM-MinGW compile in production and DH2_AUDIO_NATIVE_SESSION_FIXTURE modes.

boundaries: No production campaign source gates/settings/RNG/order changes.
No Android default control behavior change.
The Windows control is available through an explicit factory descriptor; no root caller enrollment is claimed.
